about_the_game:
◆ A Tactical Isometric RPG where Sumonsters clash in Demonster Duels!

Play as a Sumonster, a summoner and tamer of demonic (yet adorable!) creatures known as Demonsters.
Build your team and battle other Sumonsters in strategic 3v3 or 6v6 arena fights.

Summon your creatures onto tactical tiles, unleash powerful elemental abilities, use the environment to push enemies into water or the void, and win through magical abilities and clever plays.

◆ A Perilous and Mystical Adventure

The goddess Hecate has summoned you into her crumbling realm: the Demonsters have escaped from their prison-world.
Your quest? Seal them all again and uncover the dark secrets of the occult orders who set them free — especially the bizarre and mysterious group: Gogolden Dawn.

Explore a fabulous world steeped in myth, alchemy, and occult symbolism. Duel other Sumonsters, capture wild Demonsters, and add them to your team and your sacred Demonsternum, a legendary magic grimoire that catalogs all known (and forgotten) Demonsters.

◆ Mystic-Tactical Features!

  • 🎴 Capture Demonsters through a magical sealing mini-game: connect the dots to form a capture sigil!

  • 🧿 Equip your Demonsters with Talismans to enhance their power.

  • ⚗️ Use in-battle Transmutation to evolve them mid-fight — adapt your strategy or power up on the fly!

  • ✨ Unique active and passive magical effects.

  • 🔥 13 elemental types for deep strategy and combos.

  • 📖 A narrative blending fantasy legend, ancient myth, and satirical humor, set in a world of dark mysticism and wonder.

◆ About the Demo

  • This Demo is a prototype version to give you a taste of the upcoming full game.

  • The game is in active development: visuals, sounds, texts, features, and story elements are subject to change.

  • The demo includes a prologue ending, offering a first glimpse of the adventure ahead.

content_descriptors.notes:
Contains content that deals with adult themes such as Religion, Secret Societies, or Demonology.

The violence is largely represented through ridiculously over-the-top special attacks.
Impact damage can create cartoon-style blood effects.

The words “sh*t,” “b*tch,” "f*ck" and “a*s” appear in the dialogue.
